options.text: What do you see out there?

loud.text: Heel first. Everything inside a hundred paces knows you by now. The deer left an hour ago.

options.text: I don't need quiet. I need fast.

loud_sorry.text: The deer don't mind. I do. I was hungry.

loud_teach.text: Toe, then heel. Slow near a herd. They watch before they run, and one tells the rest.

loud_hard.text: Then be fast. The quiet ones eat.

tracks.text: Goblin tracks by the south road. More than last month, and deeper in the heel. They're carrying something heavy home.

options.text: And me? What do my tracks say?
